added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite gate logs: logs/base-gate.log ends 2 failed/EXIT=1 and logs/head-gate.log ends 2 passed/EXIT=0 at 7e3992f569, both failure ids being the two new cases, so added failures are zero. The population arms record a different figure and are not the source of this count: logs/population-base.log ends 27 failed/672 passed/EXIT=1 and logs/population-head.log ends 5 failed/696 passed/EXIT=1, with three head-only ids (test_idle_producer_backs_off.py::test_idle_producer_backs_off_to_the_cap_and_returns_to_base, test_producer_holds_a_lease.py::test_a_renewed_producer_outlives_three_lease_intervals, test_producer_loop_survives_a_config_change.py::test_the_producer_defers_a_broken_config_and_recovers) attributed to load at manifest.md:21; that attribution is the subject of a finding.

0.reason: landed ahead of the full importer population because the review reflex was dark for every reckon session; the coordinator runs that population at the merged head next and records the delta in the archive anchor

1.reason: the coordinator reran the one added id alone 3x on both trees: head 3 of 3 passed, base 2 of 3 failed (~/.cache/reckon-population/producer-reentry/rerun-*.log)

2.reason: the case's durable evidence rests on its other assertions, which compare the emitted row against the classifier rather than the injected state

3.reason: the coordinator's own reruns alone on both trees replace the fragment's claim; the archive anchor states the measured counts

findings.text: the done_when requires every test file under tests/ that imports runs, recovery_watch, recovery_classification or recovery_review_dispatch to run at both revisions, and the node ran a 113/114-file feature-scoped subset instead; the substitution is stated plainly here and in the evidence fragment, but the measure as written is unmet and the wider population could in principle carry an added failure the subset cannot see.

the three head-only failure ids are attributed to load, but the head arm's own log shows test_idle_producer_backs_off red 2 of 3 while the base arm's log shows the same three tests green 3 of 3 in the same window, so the arms do not share the condition the attribution names; the quieter head-only log is a single-test rerun that does not reproduce the base arm's three-test group, so the attribution is plausible but not established by the record.

`assert rows[-1]["from_state"] == "working"` compares the emitted row against the known state the test itself injects at :97, so the two sides move together and the line passes for any fold that echoes its input back; the durable evidence in this case rests on :122, :124 and :127, not on :125.

the fragment states each of the three head-only failures "passes 3/3 alone at both revisions once the node is quiet", but only the head arm has a single-test 3x log; the base evidence for that test is a three-test group run, so "alone at both revisions" overstates what was measured.
